rss.com.label: RSS.com
rss.com.notes: Publish the approved podcastAudio here first. RSS.com is the canonical audio host and feed source for Apple Podcasts and Amazon Music/Audible; do not use the full-video master as its audio asset.

spotify.label: Spotify for Creators
spotify.notes: There is no account-wide video switch. Wait for RSS.com audio to create the episode in the existing Spotify show, then use that exact episode's Upload video action with the approved fullVideo. All seven episodes are currently audio-only after the host cutover and need restoration against their existing Spotify episode IDs. Never create a duplicate episode. Spotify does not expose a public creator episode-upload API for this workflow.

apple.label: Apple Podcasts
apple.notes: Do not upload the episode separately. Apple receives the approved podcast audio and item-level episode artwork from RSS.com's canonical feed. Preserve show ID 1870433419. The duplicate Draft show and stale manual Episode 4 Draft were archived on August 6, 2026; RSS Episodes 1-2 remain DRAFTING/HIDDEN even though their feed items and audio are valid, so resolution requires Apple support rather than manual publication or recreation.

amazon.label: Amazon Music and Audible
amazon.notes: Do not upload the episode separately. After the one-time listing claim and ownership verification, Amazon Music and Audible receive the approved podcast audio from RSS.com's canonical feed.

youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.notes: Use OAuth and resumable upload. New API projects keep uploads private until YouTube completes its separate compliance audit.

vimeo.label: Vimeo
vimeo.notes: Use the official Vimeo API with upload and edit scopes after app upload access is enabled.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.notes: The public profile has exact name and bio but no external link and currently reports a non-business account. Add the website listening hub and complete professional-account/API setup before automation. Prefer Meta's resumable upload from the approved local Reel.

rumble.label: Rumble
rumble.notes: No documented public creator VOD-upload API is available. Keep final license, visibility, and monetization choices in an approved browser handoff.
